convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown indicator name 'RangeExpansionIndex' and external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> library for position management. Custom indicator must be manually reimplemented in Python, and the trade algorithm library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) need manual porting.

derived_values.name: REI buffer 0 current bar
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd_Handle, 0, SignalBar, 2, Ind) → Ind[0]=current signal bar, Ind[1]=previous bar

other_exits: Long position closes when REI[1] is above Dn_Indicator_level (Ind[1]>Dn_Indicator_level evaluates false for the first if-block, so BUY_Close=true from the else branch at line 115), which means REI moves back above -60

Short position closes when REI[1] is below Up_Indicator_level (Ind[1]<Up_Indicator_level evaluates false for the second if-block, so SELL_Close=true from the else branch at line 123), which means REI moves back below +60
BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags control whether signal-based closes are enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh determines lot sizing method; default LOT means fixed lot sizing with MM=0.1

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic detail: BUY_Open triggers when Ind[1] > Dn_Indicator_level AND Ind[0] <= Dn_Indicator_level — this is a crossover of REI dropping below -60 (bearish crossover into oversold zone used as buy signal). SELL_Open triggers when Ind[1] < Up_Indicator_level AND Ind[0] >= Up_Indicator_level — crossover of REI rising above +60 (overbought zone used as sell signal). Exit logic: BUY_Close=true when Ind[1] <= Dn_Indicator_level (else branch line 115), meaning REI stays below -60 zone. SELL_Close=true when Ind[1] >= Up_Indicator_level (else branch line 123), meaning REI stays above +60 zone. The CIsNewBar class and IsNewBar() gate ensures signals are only evaluated on new bars. Recount flag allows re-evaluation on first tick or when CopyBuffer fails. The GlobalVariableDel_ and LoadHistory are TradeAlgorithms.mqh helpers. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions likely for trade time gating or duplicate trade prevention.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the RangeExpansionIndex indicator in Python — this is the DeMark Range Expansion Index (REI) which compares high/low shifts over a lookback period. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for position management (open/close with margin modes) must be ported; the core logic is standard buy/sell with SL/TP. Entry signals are threshold crossovers on the REI indicator: buy when REI crosses below -60, sell when REI crosses above +60. Exits are signal-based (REI returning from extreme zones) combined with fixed SL/TP of 1000/2000 points. The new-bar guard should be implemented as a bar-time change detector. Deviation parameter of 10 points should be handled as slippage tolerance in backtest fill logic.
